label: Boot / Pune, India
title: Building AI products from *scratch to scale.*
body: Associate Software Engineer working across Java, Python, agentic AI and core ML, building pipelines that go from experiment to production.

label: Origin
title: Where it *started.*
body: I earned a B.E. in Computer Engineering at PES's Modern College of Engineering in Pune, from 2021 to 2025, with a 9.38 CGPA.
Alongside the degree I worked on deepfake detection: a research internship building a distributed detector on Hadoop and Spark, and FusionX, a hybrid CNN and Transformer model.

label: Foundations
title: Learning on systems where *correctness* matters.
body: I learned backend engineering by building payment-style systems as personal projects.
A UPI replication with a payment saga, a transactional outbox and idempotent postings. And FinSec Vault, a Spring Boot 3 banking backend with role-based approvals.

label: Into production
title: Into *production.*
body: At CoReCo Technologies I build services that real clients use. I took part in the POCs and a pilot that helped the company retain a client and win the purchase order.

stations.caption: Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL and Redis for client products
Speech-to-text, text-to-speech and RAG systems served as FastAPI microservices
POCs and a pilot that helped win the PO
Propel Excellence Award, after about ten months

label: FifthSense / Glovatrix
title: Teaching a system to *understand* people.
body: I designed the machine-learning pipeline that predicts gestures in real time, and I'm architecting the backend the whole platform runs on.
First pilot: Royal Orchid Hotels, Bangalore.
I have presented our work on stage at the Walchand College of Engineering Alumni Business Meet in Pune and at AI Demo Day.

quote.text: That's the only metric that really counts.
quote.source: Adhish Pawar's LinkedIn post about the Royal Orchid pilot

label: Next orbit
title: The *next* orbit.
body: I want to build IT solutions at scale, automate workflows, and build AI-based applications and products.
Over time I want to move toward core ML: model development across ML, DL and AI.

label: Explorer / after hours
title: Beyond *the terminal.*
body: Between builds I travel, move between places, and learn whatever domain is next. Tech makes more sense when life is in the same frame.

label: Connect
title: If you're building something that *matters*, let's talk.
body: Say hello on LinkedIn, or find my work on GitHub.
